[Garrison]

[{0}]

[Garrison]

[加里森]

[Garrison]
I'm a perfectionist, but due to my old age, my eyes are growing dark, and I think I may have sold defective Six Shooters.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
So what I'm trying to say is, I'm hoping someone will find me spare parts which I can use to replace defective parts in the detective Six Shooters.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
所以我想說的是，我希望有人能幫我找到備用零件，以便替換那些有缺陷的“六輪發手槍”中的故障部件。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
If you help me, I'll put a slot in that Garrison you're holding right now.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
如果你幫了我，我會在你手裡拿的那把“加里森”上開一個插槽。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Garrison]

scripts.text: Ok, I'll try it out.

scripts.text:
[Garrison]

I understand.

scripts.translation:

[N. A]
If you don't want it anymore,
you can cancel the request.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你不想要了，
你可以取消這個請求。

scripts.text: Don't cancel.
scripts.translation: 不取消

scripts.text: Cancel it.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Well, please come back with the
materials. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
好吧，請帶著材料回來。
我會在這裡等著。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Alright, request to make
a Drifter for you is cancelled.
I wish you good luck
in your future.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
好的，為你製作流浪者的請求已取消。
祝你未來一切順利。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
You are overweight.
Even if I made you the
weapon, you cannot carry it.
Please clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你超重了。
即使我為你製作了武器，
你也拿不動它。
請清理一下你的物品欄。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ahh, here's the completed
Drifter for you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，這是為你製作好的流浪者。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Please learn to use the
Gatlings well. The crazy
destruction will definitely
be mentally helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
請學會熟練使用加特林。
那種瘋狂的破壞力
絕對會讓你在精神上感到愉悅。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, hello?
I'm the Coordinator of
Einbroch Weapon Development.
My name is 'Lab Director'.
Do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你好？
我是艾音布羅克武器研發的協調員。
我的名字是“實驗室總監”。
你需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text: I need a Special Metal Rod.
scripts.translation: 我需要一根特殊金屬棒。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Huh...? Hey, weren't you that guy
who walked out of here with a
Butcher a while ago? How was the
Butcher?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
嗯...？嘿，你之前是不是那個
帶著屠夫離開這裡的人？
那把屠夫用得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
...... WHAT!? YOU BROKE IT!?
I thought you would be able to
use it well... You disappoint me!!!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
......什麼！？你把它弄壞了！？
我還以為你能用好它的...
你讓我太失望了！！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
You betrayed my faith in you!
You traitor! Traitor!! TRAITOR!!!!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你辜負了我對你的信任！
你這個叛徒！叛徒！！叛徒！！！

scripts.text: Explain everything.
scripts.translation: 解釋一切。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
...... Whew.
So it was Mr. F. Harrison who
broke it, huh? I'm sorry, I should
not have suspected you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
......呼。
原來是F. 哈里森先生弄壞的啊？
抱歉，我不該懷疑你的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Lady Celena has the special metal
rod that you want, but the doc is
not in right now, and no one else
knows where it is...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
女士那裡有你想要的那根特殊金屬棒，
但醫生現在不在，
其他人也不知道它在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have other research right now
so I can't waste my time looking
for that... Grr... I need the
Elemental Spheres to keep going
with my research...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我現在有其他研究要做，
不能浪費時間去找那個... 哼...
我需要元素球才能繼續我的研究...

scripts.text: Make him an offer.
scripts.translation: 向他提出交易。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
An offer? Like what?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
交易？比如什麼？

scripts.text: We find things for each other.
scripts.translation: 我們互相幫忙找東西。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmm... That sounds good.
Well, according to the offer,
I'll look for the rod for you,
while you find me those
Elemental Spheres.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
嗯...聽起來不錯。
好吧，按照交易，
我去幫你找那根金屬棒，
你幫我找那些元素球。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
30 Poison Sphere, 30 Flare Sphere,
30 Lightning Sphere, 30 Blind
Sphere, or 30 Freezing Sphere.
Find me 30 of each Element.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
30個毒球，30個火球，
30個雷球，30個盲球，
或者30個冰球。
每種元素各找30個給我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
30 Poison Sphere, 30 Flare Sphere,
30 Lightning Sphere, 30 Blind
Sphere, or 30 Freezing Sphere.
Find me 30 of each Element.
Did you find them?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
30個毒球，30個火球，
30個雷球，30個盲球，
或者30個冰球。
每種元素各找30個給我。
你找到了嗎？

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text: I found 30 Poison Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30個毒球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Flare Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30個火球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Lightning Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30個雷球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Blind Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30個盲球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Freezing Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30個冰球。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Just bring me whatever type
you could find.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
隨便什麼屬性的都行，
找到什麼就帶什麼來。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Eh? What? Am I the only
person who can't see them?
Bring me more!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
誒？什麼？難道只有我
看不見它們嗎？
再多帶點來！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Wow, you found them all for me!
I had to turn Lady Celena's lab
over to find this rod too.
Let's trade then!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
哇，你全都幫我找到了！
為了找這根槍管，
我不得不把賽蕾娜女士的實驗室翻了一遍。
那我們交換吧！

scripts.text:
-You gave the Elemental
Spheres to Research Coordinator and got
the Metal Rod in return.-
scripts.translation: -你將元素球交給了研究協調員，並換回了一根金屬槍管。-

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Mr. F. Harrison is very good.
I'm sure he can fix your
Butcher for you.
Well, see you later!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
F. 哈里森先生非常厲害。
我相信他能幫你修好屠夫。
好了，回頭見！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Mr. F. Harrison is very good.
I'm sure he can fix your
Butcher for you.
Well, see you later!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
F. 哈里森先生非常厲害。
我相信他能幫你修好屠夫。
好了，回頭見！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, hello?
I'm the Coordinator of
Einbroch Weapon Development.
My name is 'Lab Director'.
Do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你好？
我是艾音布羅克武器研發的協調員。
我的名字是“實驗室總監”。
你需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他談談。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you see Gunslingers around,
please tell them that I have
the latest news on weapons.
If necessary, please send them
here. Heheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你看到神槍手，
請告訴他們我有最新的武器情報。
如果有必要，請把他們引薦到這裡。
嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text:
[N. A]
... Destruction... Madness...
Hmm... Attack speed over 180...

[N. A]
Ah, sorry, I'm developing some
new weapons. Please don't
disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，抱歉，我正在研發新武器。
請不要打擾我。

scripts.text: Ask about the 'Drifter'.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於“流浪者”的事。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you heard the news
shortly after the end
of the development eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是在研發剛結束
就聽到訊息了嗎？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
^ff0000Butcher^000000 is the newest development
by us, the Einbroch Firearm Lab.
It is the newest type of Gatling
we have developed. While
^ff0000Drifter^000000 is a good weapon
as well, the ^ff0000Butcher^000000 definitely has
a much stronger firepower!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是我們艾音布羅克槍械實驗室的最新研發成果。
它是我們開發出的最新型加特林。雖然
^ff0000流浪者^000000也是一把好槍，但^ff0000屠夫^000000的火力
絕對要強大得多！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Due to its strong firepower,
the Butcher was also dubbed
as the 'Murderer'.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由於火力強勁，
屠夫也被人稱為“殺手”。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
However, even Gunslingers could
have troubles controlling such
a powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
不過，即使是神槍手，
想要控制這麼強大的武器
也會感到吃力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you think you can handle it?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你覺得你能駕馭它嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不確定...

scripts.text: Of course I can!!
scripts.translation: 我當然可以！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Butcher^000000 is a weapon that you
can't handle without a strong
will. I'll see you again when
you have enough confidence to
handle this monster.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是一把沒有強大意志
就無法駕馭的武器。等你有足夠的自信
能駕馭這個怪物時，我們再見面吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Aha, how self-confident you
are! However, I see people with
such self-confidence everywhere.
You'll need to prove it...
But how... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈，你真是自信滿滿啊！不過，
我到處都見過這種自信滿滿的人。
你得證明一下...
但是怎麼證明呢... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmmm......

[N. A]
Aha! I got it!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈！我想到了！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Here, bring me ^ff00001000 Orc Claws^000000 and ^ff00001000 Skel Bone^000000.
If you can bring me these items,
I'll let you use the Butcher.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
給我帶^ff00001000個獸人指甲^000000和^ff00001000根骷髏骨頭^000000來。
如果你能帶這些材料給我，
我就讓你使用屠夫。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Easy, ain't it? Go and prove
your ability then! Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
很簡單吧？那就去證明你的實力吧！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you're here to learn about
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是來打聽^ff0000流浪者^000000的吧？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Drifter^000000 is one of the many
highest-classed weapons developed
by Lady Celena. It's an automatic
Gatling which boasts very high
rate of fire, which is the highest
among all Gunslinger weapons.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000流浪者^000000是賽琳娜女士開發的眾多最高階武器之一。它是一把自動加特林機槍，擁有極高的射速，是所有神槍手武器中射速最高的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Of course, you will need the Skill
to allow you to control Gatlings,
but he who contorls Gatlings well
will receive full aid from the
^ff0000Drifter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
當然，你需要擁有控制加特林機槍的技能，但那些能熟練操控加特林的人，將能充分發揮^ff0000流浪者^000000的威力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you want to try using the ^ff0000Drifter^000000?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你想試試使用^ff0000流浪者^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Um, no.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text: Yeah!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you want to try it out
some time, come back here.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你以後想試試，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Since it's really hard to find
the materials for constructing
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000, we only make them
on requests, and we require those
who want to use the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 to bring
us the materials.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
因為製造^ff0000流浪者^000000的材料很難找到，我們只接受定製訂單，並要求想要使用^ff0000流浪者^000000的人自己提供材料。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I'll tell you the materials
needed, just bring them and
we'll construct it for you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我會告訴你需要的材料，只要把它們帶過來，我們就為你製造。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
To make a Drifter, we need
70 Steel, 5 Eluniums, 3
Oridecons, 70 Coal, 50 Rusty
Screws, and a fee of
50,000 zeny.
Come back after you found
them all.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
製造一把流浪者，需要70個鋼鐵、5個鋁、3個神之金屬、70個煤炭、50個生鏽螺絲，以及50,000 Zeny的手續費。
集齊所有材料後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have news on the latest
weapons but... I guess you're
too busy to hear them.
Maybe next time I guess.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我有最新武器的訊息，但...看來你太忙了沒空聽。
也許下次吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
You are overweight.
Even if I gave you the
weapon, you cannot carry it.
Please clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
你超重了。
就算我把武器給你，你也拿不動。
請清理一下你的物品欄。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh...... Eh?

[F. Harrison]
Heheh... Hmm... Huh...?
May I have my Butcher back now?
scripts.translation: 現在可以把屠夫還給我了嗎？

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Uh? Oh, umm... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呃？哦，嗯...嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Th-that, huh? Eh... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那...那個，是嗎？呃...嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Ahahahah! I uh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈哈哈哈哈！那個...呃...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
That thing! BOOM!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
就是那個東西！轟！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Bam bam! I was gonna fire it!
Yeah!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
砰！砰！我本來想開槍的！
沒錯！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But it resisted! So I went 'BAM!' with
my hand! MUAHAHAHAH!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
但它抵抗了！所以我用手“砰”地打了一下！穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
And it broke...... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
然後它就壞了...... *抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I call myself 'Dr. Everything' and
I wanted to fix it myself, but I
don't seem to have the materials
to fix it... And the materials are
so rare too... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我自稱“全能博士”，本想自己修好它，但我似乎沒有修理所需的材料... 而且那些材料非常稀有... *抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Umm... I'm sorry for breaking
it but... Could you get me the
materials I need for fixing it?
Bring me those items, and I can
fix it, plus I'll modify it for
you! I promise!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嗯... 很抱歉弄壞了它，但是... 你能幫我弄到修理所需的材料嗎？
把那些物品帶給我，我就能修好它，還會為你改裝它！我保證！！

scripts.text:
So please bring me the materials...
*sob sob sob*
scripts.translation:
所以請帶給我那些材料...
*抽泣抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
I think only Lady Celena can
make those rods......
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10個鋼，2個鋁，
1個神之金屬，20個煤炭...
還有一根屠夫用的
特殊金屬棒...
我想只有塞琳娜女士
才能製作那些金屬棒......

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But first, you'll need to talk
to Lady Celena's assistant, the 'Lab Director',
and ask for his help.
That kid's a bit hysterical, but
she'll be nice help if you talk
to her nicely...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
但首先，你需要去和塞琳娜女士的助手，
也就是“實驗室總監”談談，
請求他的幫助。
那個小孩有點情緒化，但
如果你好好跟她說話，
她會很有幫助的...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I'm really sorry... Here, I'll
lend you my prized weapon,
'Crimson Bolt'. But make sure
you bring all those materials
to me once you find them all!
Promise me!!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
真的很抱歉... 這裡，我把我的
得意武器“鮮紅閃電手槍”借給你。
但請務必在找到所有材料後
把它們都帶給我！
答應我！！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Talk to the 'Lab Director' for his
assistance on the Rod.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10個鋼，2個鋁，
1個神之金屬，20個煤炭...
還有一根屠夫用的
特殊金屬棒...
去找“實驗室總監”
尋求關於金屬棒的協助。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me! I'll get to the repair
right away, please hold on...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你為我找到了所有材料！
我馬上開始修理，請稍等...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me!
... But where's my treasured
'Crimson Bolt'!? I will not fix
your Butcher for you if you don't
bring it back to me!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你為我找到了所有材料！
... 但是我的寶貝“鮮紅閃電手槍”在哪裡！？
如果你不把它還給我，
我就不會幫你修理屠夫！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Good thing you found the
Special Metal Rod already.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10個鋼，2個鋁，
1個神之金屬，20個煤炭...
還有一根屠夫用的
特殊金屬棒...
幸好你已經找到了
那根特殊金屬棒。

scripts.text:
-You're overweight already.-
-Come back after dropping some
stuff first.-
scripts.translation:
-你已經超重了。-
-請先丟棄一些物品再來。-

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Whew... Finally it's fixed, thanks
to your effort. I'm very sorry
for breaking it, and thank you
for your effort. I feel guilty
for just fixing it, so I added
some extra power on it. I hope
it'll work nicely for you.
Well, enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呼... 終於修好了，多虧了你的努力。
我很抱歉弄壞了它，也感謝你的付出。
光是修好它讓我感到愧疚，所以我額外增加了一些威力。
希望它能讓你滿意。
那麼，盡情使用吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
天哪，我好無聊...
不知道有沒有什麼有趣的事情...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Oh well... I'll just play with my
beautiful 'Crimson Bolt'.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
算了... 我就玩玩我漂亮的“鮮紅閃電手槍”吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
天哪，我好無聊...
不知道有沒有什麼有趣的事情...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Eh? Are you a Gunslinger?
I haven't seen that weapon
in your hand before...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
咦？你是神槍手嗎？
我以前沒見過你手裡拿著那把武器...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
May I take a look? Please?
C'mon, let me take a look!
I'm bored out of my mind here!
Pleeeeeeeeeeeease~?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
可以讓我看看嗎？拜託了！
快讓我看看嘛！
我在這裡無聊死了！
求求你啦~？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 給你...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hah! You think you're the only
one with a cool weapon!? Well
I got my beautiful Crimson Bolt!
Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈！你以為只有你有酷炫的武器嗎？
我可是有我漂亮的鮮紅閃電手槍！
哼！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... This is the newest
development by Einbroch Firearms
Lab, the so-called uncontrollable
'Destroyer Butcher', eh?
Interesting... VERY interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿嘿... 這是艾音布羅克槍械實驗室的最新研發成果，
所謂的不可控“毀滅屠夫”，是嗎？
有意思... 非常有意思...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hey, let me try it out for a
bit, alright? Don't worry, I
know how to handle weapons,
I won't break it!
That's that! Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿，讓我試玩一會兒，好嗎？
別擔心，我很擅長使用武器，
不會弄壞的！
就是這樣！我們走~
